note: The Åland Islands, an autonomous region of Finland, are fully in the Schengen Area with no border controls of their own: a visitor meets the EU's common list (the eu1806 list).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Schengen Area: territories and European microstates
sources.said: The Åland Islands (an autonomous region of Finland ) are fully integrated into the Schengen Area. Åland does not maintain any external border controls or mandatory identity checks for movement to and from other Schengen member states.
